notes: DOI TEN FILE VIDEO THEO NGON NGU DA CHON (truoc day luon tieng Anh). 1) Prompt tao ten video ghim cung 'English' o 3 cho -> nay dung ngon ngu dang chon (vi du tieng Tay Ban Nha: tieu de + hashtag deu tieng Tay Ban Nha). 2) Hashtag du phong khi AI khong tra du 3 the: truoc day luon #story #drama #fullstory -> nay theo ngon ngu (#historia #drama #final cho Tay Ban Nha, #truyen #tamly #fullstory cho tieng Viet...), va PHAI ASCII (khong dau) vi ten file di qua o mang/WebDAV. 3) Cau chen trong ten file theo ngon ngu: them DEFAULT_FILENAME_PHRASES_BY_LANGUAGE cho du 16 ngon ngu + filename_phrases_for_language(). Neu nguoi dung da tu nhap danh sach thi TON TRONG ban tu nhap (khong ghi de). O 'Cau chien trong ten file' trong GUI tu doi khi doi ngon ngu (chi khi dang la mac dinh). 4) FIX: cau chen ten file chua duoc bo dau -> ten file thanh non-ASCII (vi du 'XEM TRON BO PHIM TAI DAY' co dau) de loi tren o mang. Nay bo dau truoc khi ghep ten file. Da test: 16/16 ngon ngu co cau chen rieng + ten file ASCII <= 219 ky tu; prompt doi ten dung ngon ngu; ban tu nhap duoc giu nguyen.
